svg.title: Active users by country
svg.desc: Bar chart of Users (k) by Country. Highest: Germany (820); lowest: Denmark (156).

g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Users (k)' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 900
Y-axis titled 'Country' for a discrete scale with 12 values: Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, ending with Denmark
